End-to-End Methodology

Core Analytical Capabilities

How I take raw, unstructured business data from ingestion to executive decision-making.

01

Data Cleaning & ETL Pipelines

Ingesting messy multi-sheet Excel workbooks and relational tables using Power Query (M) and Python (Pandas)—isolating control rows, treating missing values, and unpivoting wide schedules into clean records.

02

Data Modeling & SQL Databases

Architecting scalable Star Schema Data Models with clean Fact and Dimension tables, surrogate keys, and One-to-Many relationships alongside complex SQL Server querying.

03

BI Dashboards & DAX Engineering

Engineering dynamic DAX measures to track collection rates, sales KPIs, and variance trends inside interactive Power BI, Tableau, and Excel executive dashboards.

04

AI & Statistical Problem Solving

Applying Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), statistical reasoning, and AI preference-matching logic to uncover hidden patterns and automate intelligent recommendations.
